name: examcoach-security-testing

scripts.test:after: newman run postman/ExamCoach-Security-Audit.postman_collection.json -e postman/ExamCoach-Local-Dev.postman_environment.json --folder "Finding 1 - Unauthenticated Quiz CRUD (A01)" --folder "Finding 2 - Quiz Answer Key Exposed Before Submission (A06)" --folder "Finding 3 - IDOR on Student Profile (A01) [Requires one-time setup]" --folder "Finding 4 - Missing Authentication on AI Summary History (A01)" --folder "Finding 5 - Hardcoded Default Admin Credentials (A07)" --folder "Finding 6 - Wildcard CORS (A02)" --folder "Finding 7 - Plaintext Quiz Password Disclosure (A04)" --folder "Finding 8 - Sensitive Data Logged in Plaintext (A09) [Check server console]" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export postman/reports/AFTER-fix-report.html
scripts.test:optional-cloudinary: newman run postman/ExamCoach-Security-Audit.postman_collection.json --folder "OPTIONAL - Live Cloudinary Hardcoded Secret Verification" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export postman/reports/optional-cloudinary-report.html
